Package domain.model

Class Hidato

java.lang.Object
domain.model.Hidato
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Hexagon, Square, Triangle
public abstract class Hidato extends Object implements Cloneable
Abstract class representing the Hidato puzzle. It contains the basic structure, attributes, and file-parsing logic required to manage an Hidato game

      public Hidato(UUID idH, int numCells, int numHoles)
      Constructor by ID and Cell parameters.
      Parameters:
      idH - Unique identifier for the Hidato.
      numCells - Total number of cells (between 3 and 200).
      numHoles - Number of non-accessible cells in the board.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if numCells is not within the range [3, 200].

    • setCell

      public void setCell(int id, int value)
      Sets the value of a cell based on its calculated ID. Assumes the ID maps to a standard row-major index mapping using the number of columns.
      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the cell (calculated as: row * cols_ + col + 1).
      value - The integer value to assign to the cell.

    • getValue

      public int getValue(int id)

      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the cell (calculated as: row * cols_ + col + 1).
      Returns:
      The numerical value contained in the cell.

    • isHole

      public boolean isHole(int id)
      Checks if a cell is a hole based on its calculated ID.
      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the cell (calculated as: row * cols_ + col + 1).
      Returns:
      True if the cell is a hole, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the calculated index is out of bounds.
